description: osirAppCreateUpload: Create an upload ticket for deploying app source code to Osir. Returns an uploadTicket, a putUrl, and instructions to zip the project and upload it. After uploading, call osirAppDeploy with the uploadTicket. Requires authentication.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: osirAppCreateUpload
